hero.title: Agent Marketplace
hero.description: The agents that are live on the platform and open to customers — digital employees, professional software agents and embodied agents. Sign in to subscribe for free, then integrate and orchestrate them by plan.

agents.title: The agent lineup
agents.description: This list comes straight from the platform product catalog: live agents show a Stable badge and can be subscribed to directly, while those still in the works show In development — each flips to subscribable as it truly ships.

developing.name: Contract Review Agent
developing.description: For procurement, sales, legal, and project management, automatically identifies contract clause risks, missing terms, obligations, and approval concerns.
developing.value: Reduces manual review effort and gives business teams structured risk hints before approval submission.

developing.name: Digital Legal Agent
developing.description: Uses enterprise policies, regulations, historical cases, and Q&A knowledge to support legal consultation, policy retrieval, and document drafting.
developing.value: Turns common legal questions into self-service answers while keeping citations and review trails.

developing.name: Business Analysis Agent
developing.description: Connects operating metrics, finance data, customer data, and project progress to generate daily briefs, anomaly alerts, and cause analysis.
developing.value: Helps managers move from reading dashboards to asking business questions and finding root causes faster.

developing.name: Battlefield Simulation Agent
developing.description: Supports complex situation simulation, resource-constraint assessment, and plan comparison with explainable and reviewable tabletop assistance.
developing.value: Helps teams run situation simulation and plan evaluation within safety boundaries, improving simulation efficiency and review quality.

developing.name: Drone Monitoring Agent
developing.description: Connects drone imagery, flight tasks, spatial grids, and alert rules to identify anomalies and generate inspection reports.
developing.value: Turns drone-collected data into assignable tasks and traceable response loops.

developing.name: Data Governance Agent
developing.description: Supports data asset inventory, quality checks, metric definition explanation, and lineage analysis for an intelligent data foundation.
developing.value: Lowers the barrier to data governance so business users can understand data sources, quality issues, and metric definitions.

developing.name: Emergency Command Agent
developing.description: Provides continuous assistance for incident situation fusion, plan matching, resource dispatch, and task tracking.
developing.value: Unifies event summaries, response suggestions, team and supply status, and acknowledgements into one command chain.

developing.name: Urban Risk Assessment Agent
developing.description: Integrates people, vehicles, places, events, and risk-source data to continuously discover urban public safety and governance risks.
developing.value: Turns cross-agency clues into explainable risk lists and spatial situation views for earlier intervention.

developing.name: Industrial Equipment Inspection Agent
developing.description: Connects equipment sensors, inspection records, repair tickets, and expert knowledge to identify abnormal trends and suggest actions.
developing.value: Helps factories move from scheduled inspection to predictive maintenance, reducing downtime and repeated diagnosis.

developing.name: Proposal Writing Agent
developing.description: Uses enterprise knowledge, product material, and historical bids to assist with proposal outlines, response points, and differentiation.
developing.value: Lets presales teams create editable drafts quickly and spend more time on customer insight and solution refinement.

developing.name: Supply Chain Collaboration Agent
developing.description: Connects procurement, inventory, logistics, suppliers, and delivery milestones to monitor exceptions and suggest actions.
developing.value: Finds delivery risks earlier and turns cross-team communication into trackable task flows.

developing.name: Low-altitude Resource Dispatch Agent
developing.description: Supports mission orchestration, resource matching, and execution tracking for low-altitude inspection, emergency communication, delivery, and airspace resources.
developing.value: Upgrades low-altitude resources from one-off task execution into schedulable, reviewable, and collaborative business capability.
